|game_text=Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, which prints the original release-sheet words again. The image here is that card image ([[:File:VB2-L-shockinginformation-pre.gif]]); it was on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013, the folder's bulk upload date.
* '''Original''' ([[Shocking Information (V)]]): Virtual Block 2 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 153)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=10 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 10, slip 153. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-153-Shocking_Information.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 153 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Shocking Information (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 2 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1220_153">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock2Type (Virtual Block 2 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ a character, ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text), or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).” '''What changed:''' One change: “▲ or ▼ a character” becomes “▲ a character, ▼ a character” (the character is named twice), with a comma added before “or just drew”. The list writes the icons out as “took a character into hand from Reserve Deck, deployed a character from Reserve Deck”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-shockinginformation-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual2-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual2-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034559/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (153).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Shocking Information (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 36)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=36 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1220-153-front-master.png]]: “Unless you have a senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
